principles: AAB defines the requirements; infrastructure must qualify against AAB.
Protected country scientific information and derivatives must not return to canonical AAB.

controls.precondition: catalogues collected from canonical and reconstructed environment
controls.action: compare exact RPC identities, properties and execute roles
controls.prohibited: unexpected PUBLIC, anon, authenticated or service_role execution

controls.action: exercise positive and negative authority paths
controls.prohibited: caller-supplied authority elevation or revoked/cross-country success

controls.precondition: RLS class and boundary evidence available
controls.action: verify schema, table, view and RPC reachability
controls.expected: documented RLS or verified non-RLS server boundary
controls.failure: EVIDENCE REQUIRED or TECHNICAL VERIFICATION NOT SATISFIED
